is_anopheles.evidence: The paper is a malariometric survey of human participants, not a study of mosquito populations. While it references a separate entomological study (Ant et al., 2020) in the discussion, this paper itself does not genotype mosquito markers.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper does not report any insecticide-resistance marker genotyping for mosquitoes.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No mosquito genotype data is provided.

african_field_population.evidence: The study focuses on human participants in Guinea-Bissau, not mosquito populations.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study of human malaria prevalence.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study was conducted on the island of Bubaque, Guinea-Bissau.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study was conducted in August 2017.

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a primary survey of human malaria prevalence.

supplement.evidence: The paper does not contain mosquito genotype data, so no supplement is needed for that purpose.

assessment.summary: This paper is a cross-sectional survey of Plasmodium falciparum malaria prevalence in human participants on the island of Bubaque, Guinea-Bissau. It does not contain any entomological data or mosquito genotype information.
